QUOTE: The post is written to the local database before the network call, so it shows in the channel right away. ... If `client.createPost` throws, the record is updated with `props.failed: true` and kept under its pending ID
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both the write-to-local-DB-before-send and that on failure the post is kept and marked `props.failed: true`.
